# Human digest — open-usum-multiroute (wave 3)

Routine update after 5 completed context windows
(cadence: every 5). Breakers interrupt immediately regardless.

## Mission state (from the ledgers)
- nodes: 31 known, 26 solid
- results: 27 rows (latest per id)
- open obligations: 24
  - [OB-oum-commutation-soundness] The commutation rule must give BPC-equal products on every swap of independent steps up to the order used.
  - [OB-oum-route-completeness] Routes beyond the search depth (orbit order > 2, glue-form pairs outside the table scope, derivations through alternativ
  - [OB-oum-i1-order3] I1 (product multiset = union of the inputs') must hold on every order-3 step for the I1-filtered search to be complete.
  - [OB-oum-route-weight-disagreement] Derivation and glue-form route weights use different normalisations (single-copy class weight vs glue-form W without the
  - [OB-oum-route-reading-expert] Which reading of a multiply-reached manifold the open universal sum uses (AS-oum-route-sum or AS-oum-amplitude-once) is 
  - [OB-oum-violation-two-routes] A violation is admitted only with both certificates (OB-oup-violation-both-certificates); a non-saturated pair is report
  - [OB-oum-zero-every-word] A Z3 certificate must cover every word up to its order whose product is not certified distinct.
  - [OB-oum-order4-subset] The order-4 route search runs on a seeded subset; a full order-4 decision of routes is open and those entries carry 'rou
  - [OB-oum-d3-order3-lease] D3 at glued order 3 is attempted only where it fits the lease; the tables left out are listed.
  - [OB-oum-annulus-rmt] The comparison of the two-annulus amplitude with the g = 0, n = 2 random-matrix result of arXiv:2512.05045 is not perfor
